title: Staying safe in an earthquake
kind: 说明文 · 地震发生时室内外的避险方法

timeline.text: Earthquakes can occur anytime without warning. So it is important to be prepared and know how to protect yourself.
What should you do if one happens? Stay calm as the earth begins to shake.
If you are inside when the earthquake starts, get under a table or a bed. You need to have something strong around you to protect you from falling objects.
Do not stand near walls or windows. Stay out of the kitchen. Also, never get into a lift during an earthquake.
If you are outside, get to an open area as fast as you can. Stay away from buildings and trees.
If you are in a vehicle, pull over to a place far from trees or tall buildings and stay in the car.
If you are close to the sea, try to get as far away from the water as possible.
Earthquakes can cause huge, dangerous waves that appear rapidly.
When the earthquake is over, there is still plenty of danger. If you see a fire, quickly move outdoors to an open area.
Keep an eye out for things that can fall on you. Only make necessary phone calls. Too many calls will bring down the phone system.
Staying calm can improve your chances of survival in an earthquake. It is not easy, but it can save your life.
